detail.longDescription: Seeing this take everywhere lately: coding agents will eat the entire devtool category. Why pay for a linter, a migration tool, a monitoring integration, a testing product, when the agent just... does it? Are devtools dead, or is it specifically human-workflow devtools that are dead while agent-infrastructure becomes a big category? Will this last or will LLMs getting better eradicate the whole field as demand gets lower and lower? I want to know what have you stopped paying for since adopting agents, and what have you started paying for?
